name: Theresa Wardon Benz
tagline: Top rated Appellate attorney in Denver, Colorado
about: Theresa Wardon Benz, an attorney with Davis Graham in Denver, Colorado, helps clients address Appellate situations.
She received legal training from Northwestern University School of Law. She graduated from law school in 2008. Theresa Benz became licensed to practice law in 2009.
Theresa Benz was selected to Super Lawyers. The designation means that she is a top-rated attorney as recognized by peers. She was selected to Super Lawyers for 2022 - 2027.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
